## Tsuppari

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/tsuppari.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

## Shiko

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/shiko.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

Sumo. The user raises a leg high and stamps it down: the ground shakes around them, everyone on it thrown up, stumbling and slowed, and for five seconds the user is planted: no blow moves them.

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/uwatenage.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

## Yokozuna Charge

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/yokozuna_charge.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

Sumo. A yokozuna's charge: everyone in the way is bowled aside and out of the ring, the ground quaking where it ends. The bigger the user (their health), the harder it hits. Needs empty hands.
